stages.name: Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR)
stages.description: Risk awareness, emergency preparedness, first aid, shelter, evacuation, and immediate survival.

stages.name: Biodiversity & Survival Ecology
stages.description: Species identification, ecological knowledge, useful plants, and responsible use of biological resources.

stages.name: Water & Sanitation
stages.description: Finding, collecting, treating, storing, and safely managing water and sanitation.

stages.name: Agriculture & Food Systems
stages.description: Growing food, soil care, seeds, irrigation, food preservation, and resilient food systems.

stages.name: Energy & Mechanics
stages.description: Practical energy generation, motors, generators, mechanical power, batteries, and repair.

stages.name: Materials & Construction
stages.description: Building materials and processes including clay, brick, lime, mortar, concrete, glass, and polymers.

stages.name: Tools, Chemistry & Manufacturing
stages.description: Tools, workshops, measurement, basic chemistry, metalworking, and making or repairing equipment.

stages.name: Infrastructure & Civilization
stages.description: Community systems, communications, public health, transport, governance, and resilient infrastructure.
